newsitem.title: USA: BDM Intl to post $0.22/shr charge.
newsitem.headline: BDM Intl to post $0.22/shr charge.

text.p: BDM International Inc said on Monday it will post a restructuring charge of $0.22 a share.
The timing of the charge was not immediately available.
BDM International said it aims to realign its strategic business units into four groups to position the company for future growth, BDM said.
As part of the restructuring, the company is cutting 40 jobs across the company, writing off its investment in its environmental subsidiary, and accruing certain facility expenses, BDM said.
BDM senior vice president Todd Stottlemyer said the charge will be taken in the third quarter. The company will report its financial results for the period on October 16, 1996.
BDM said it is revamping its units into Federal Systems, State and Local Systems, Integrated Supply Chain Solutions, BDM Europe/IABG.
The company also has an Enterprise Management Services unit that serves government clients in the United States and abroad.
